title: rlw-red-crown-championship
label: Ivan Dalkichev

won.source: RLW's own Rush Hour broadcast (11 January 2015): Ivan Dalkichev defeated Russ Spackler in the Red Crown Tournament final to become the inaugural champion, served under this wing.

note: RLW's own record ends with Dalkichev still champion; a title match against The Second Coming was advertised for Mass Transit, but that show's own script was never completed and no result survives anywhere in the held record.
